'''bounty hunter6 furry fury - fun''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Published:''' 25 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]

== Strategy ==

I've always wanted to see one of these be built, but it never happened so im making one....Suprise Counter Assualt lets unlimited non-unique ewoks (for free)be deployed for reserve deck...Kazak makes force drains +1 and Graak makes it come from reserve deck which is painfull...This deck has all the endor sites too and generation is +1 at each because of The Shield is Down...Na Shardda Wind Chimes lets you retrieve lots of force right after you use Suprise Counter Assualt...This deck is just for fun but its acually pretty good for a FUN deck...be careful with the ratings...
